Day rollover verified: ledger.overhead ≈ 226.9 × sim_day (day 6 → $1361.4), diesel drifted to 3.68±, spot 0.90-1.14, day events with 'DOE diesel' + 'overhead accrued'. Copilot: /state returns goal_weekly_net=20000, week.overhead=1587.4 (13-line breakdown), progress_pct, gap_to_goal, loads_needed_per_week; /compliance seeds 20 items sorted critical-first (BOC-3, BMC-84, FMCSA, carrier vetting, cargo claims 49 CFR 370, records 49 CFR 371.3, double-brokering — all critical first); POST /compliance/{id}/status {status:met} increments met count; {status:bogus}→422; dispatcher CAN set status (200); unauthenticated→401. /plan already existed with 4 phases × 7 tasks each with task_id, toggle flips done. /chat multi-turn with session 'test-sess-iter67': msg1 grounded numeric reply ('weekly net margin', 'gap $20,225'), msg2 continuity ('143 loads/wk needed'), /chat/test-sess-iter67 returns ≥4 msgs. /briefing/latest returns None (no prior briefing generated; skipped generation to save LLM budget as instructed). Frontend Playwright (admin): /growth-copilot renders data-testid growth-copilot-page + gc-goal-card ($-225 net) + gc-net-week + all 4 gc-phase-0..3 + gc-compliance-card (20 items, all statuses buttons visible) + 28 plan tasks — clicking first task toggles state; clicking gc-comp-CMP-9759CE-met flipped compliance count from 0/20 to 1/20 met and the item moved out of the visible critical group; chat send returned a full grounded AI response in 30s ('Cost discipline, next 4 weeks benchmark targets, Double load count, Raise average margin, Collect AR, Bottom Line You're $20,225/week short') — chat integration verified via visible response text (data-testid gc-chat-msg-* not found in DOM but response text IS present). /sandbox renders sim-market-strip (DOE Diesel $3.68/gal · Spot BALANCED · idx 1 · Fixed overhead $226.9/day (13 expense lines) · Claims 1.5% · Bad debt 2% · Fall-through 6%) after clicking sim-launch-btn. Regression: /api/sentinel/status=200, /api/route-optimizer/loads=200, daniel@oriseifreight.com password login returns role=owner. Sandbox reset at end of tests (5 loads/6 events/1 sim/5 bookings/5 shipments purged), compliance item restored to action_needed.

critical_code_review_comments: growth_copilot.py: _business_state() reads brokerage_bookings via async for cursor and computes revenue/margin in Python — fine at current volume but should switch to $match+$group aggregation once weekly loads > 500. Non-blocking.

growth_copilot.py: _ensure_compliance_seed() checks count_documents == 0 — if a compliance item is ever deleted individually, the seed re-inserts all 20 with new UUIDs on next call, potentially duplicating. Consider seeding by known stable item_id or category+title match.
growth_copilot.py: /plan/generate calls .with_model('anthropic', 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929') hard-coded — worth extracting to env var so model can be rotated without redeploy.

growth_copilot.py: /chat inserts user+assistant with the SAME timestamp `at` — history sort by 'at' can rely on insertion order but a strict sort would flip them. Add microsecond offset or a monotonic seq.

sim_week.py: OVERHEAD_DAY_TOTAL is computed once at module load (226.9). Correct. However the ledger.overhead is initialized to OVERHEAD_DAY_TOTAL (day 1 baseline) then accrued on rollover — this means day-1 overhead is single-counted (good), and day-N total after N-1 rollovers = OVERHEAD_DAY_TOTAL * N. Verified via test.

sim_week.py: `passes = max(1, min(6, int(sim_hours // 2) + 1))` — at 60x speed / 3s real = 3min sim, sim_hours=0.05, passes=1. At day-boundary jumps (when clock skips over 00:00), advance loop may under-process. Non-blocking under normal tick cadence.

sim_week.py: /reset is protected by require_role('admin', 'dispatcher') but /start also require_role('admin', 'dispatcher') — fine. However /tick uses get_current_user only, so any authenticated user (driver) can advance the sim clock. Consider role-gating /tick too.
sim_week.py: _gen_load computes `rpm = rpm * lane_mult * seas_mult * spot_index` after already using `rpm` from dict lookup — variable reused. Cosmetic.

growth_copilot.py + sim_week.py: WEEKLY_OVERHEAD (copilot) = OVERHEAD_DAILY × 7 by design, but the two are NOT programmatically linked (two separate dicts). If OVERHEAD_DAILY changes, WEEKLY_OVERHEAD does NOT auto-update. Consider deriving one from the other.

Test seed drift: /app/memory/test_credentials.md says both admin+dispatcher session tokens are seeded on backend startup, but only admin session was present in user_sessions. Suggests server.py startup seed either lost the dispatcher branch or ran only partial. Non-critical since /api/auth/dev-session covers admin, but role-403 tests break without the dispatcher token.
